title: 壩體滲流監測
subcategoryTitle: 壩工監測、溢洪與壓力水路
subcategoryTitleEn: Dam monitoring, spillways and pressure waterways
summary: 本課以以水頭流量與含砂證據辨識壩體滲流演變為主線，先用總水頭與共同基準與達西流量與梯度界定水力與構造條件，再將孔壓響應與延遲、含砂濃度與輸砂連結到基線殘差與不確定度。採飽和等溫一維或集中參數示意，實際壩體可能非均質且具暫態儲水。 每單元以原創算例、量測與失效辨識共同檢查推論。
summaryEn: This course develops diagnosing dam seepage through head discharge and sediment evidence through Total head and common datum and Darcy discharge and gradient, then connects Piezometer response and lag and Suspended concentration and sediment flux to Baseline residual and uncertainty. Saturated isothermal one-dimensional or lumped examples do not represent heterogeneous transient dam foundations. Each unit combines original calculation, measurement and failure diagnosis to test the inference.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「總水頭與共同基準」與「達西流量與梯度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Total head and common datum" and "Darcy discharge and gradient": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 總水頭與共同基準：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Total head and common datum: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「總水頭與共同基準」如何影響壩體滲流監測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Total head and common datum” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Seepage monitoring in dams”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 孔壓計讀到的是量測位置的壓力，必須加上測點高程才能與庫水位比較；換用不同高程基準會製造假的水力坡降。先辨認壓力是否為表壓並扣除大氣補償，再確認管線氣泡與感測器零點，低水頭不必然代表低孔隙壓力。 驗證時應將測點水準成果與同日人工水位管讀值交叉比較，並辨識以下失效情境：壓力基準或高程更新未同步會使整組水頭產生固定偏移。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「總水頭與共同基準」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A piezometer measures pressure at its own elevation; add elevation head before comparing it with reservoir stage. Mixing vertical datums creates a false gradient. Identify gauge versus absolute pressure and atmospheric compensation, then inspect trapped air and zero offsets; low total head does not necessarily mean low local pore pressure. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare surveyed sensor elevations against same-day manual standpipe readings. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Unsynchronized pressure or elevation references produce a persistent offset across the head series. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Total head and common datum” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：z=142 m; gaugePressure=196.2 kPa; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; totalHead=142+196.2/9.81=162 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: z=142 m; gaugePressure=196.2 kPa; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; totalHead=142+196.2/9.81=162 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「孔壓數值可以直接與不同高程的水位相比」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Pressure values can be compared directly with water level at any elevation" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「總水頭與共同基準」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Total head and common datum”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 總水頭與共同基準
knowledge.text: 孔壓計讀到的是量測位置的壓力，必須加上測點高程才能與庫水位比較；換用不同高程基準會製造假的水力坡降。先辨認壓力是否為表壓並扣除大氣補償，再確認管線氣泡與感測器零點，低水頭不必然代表低孔隙壓力。
knowledge.textEn: A piezometer measures pressure at its own elevation; add elevation head before comparing it with reservoir stage. Mixing vertical datums creates a false gradient.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：孔壓數值可以直接與不同高程的水位相比 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Pressure values can be compared directly with water level at any elevation Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「壩體滲流監測」的「總水頭與共同基準：機制與系統路徑」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出流域、入流、儲存、出流與下游的水量邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「洪水量測與河道模型」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與同時間窗的流量、水位、截面與儀器校正紀錄的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Total head and common datum: mechanism and system paths” in “Seepage monitoring in dams”. Draw the catchment, inflow, storage, outflow and downstream water balance; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Flood gauging and river model” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for flow, level, section and calibration records for the same time window, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「總水頭與共同基準」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Total head and common datum" is correct?
options: 孔壓數值可以直接與不同高程的水位相比
孔壓計讀到的是量測位置的壓力，必須加上測點高程才能與庫水位比較；換用不同高程基準會製造假的水力坡降。
流量上升就足以證明壩體正在遭到侵蝕
optionsEn: Pressure values can be compared directly with water level at any elevation
A piezometer measures pressure at its own elevation; add elevation head before comparing it with reservoir stage.
Rising flow alone proves active erosion within the dam
quiz.explanation: 孔壓計讀到的是量測位置的壓力，必須加上測點高程才能與庫水位比較；換用不同高程基準會製造假的水力坡降。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A piezometer measures pressure at its own elevation; add elevation head before comparing it with reservoir stage. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 總水頭與共同基準：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Total head and common datum: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「總水頭與共同基準」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Total head and common datum” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：z=142 m; gaugePressure=196.2 kPa; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; totalHead=142+196.2/9.81=162 m。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: z=142 m; gaugePressure=196.2 kPa; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; totalHead=142+196.2/9.81=162 m. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將測點水準成果與同日人工水位管讀值交叉比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare surveyed sensor elevations against same-day manual standpipe readings.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：z=142 m; gaugePressure=196.2 kPa; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; totalHead=142+196.2/9.81=162 m。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: z=142 m; gaugePressure=196.2 kPa; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; totalHead=142+196.2/9.81=162 m. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「總水頭與共同基準」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Total head and common datum", which statement holds?
options: 所有集水槽流量都是穿越壩體的地下水
季節流量增加就表示孔隙已被沖大
原創教學假設：z=142 m; gaugePressure=196.2 kPa; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; totalHead=142+196.2/9.81=162 m。
optionsEn: Every collected drainage flow is groundwater passing through the dam
Seasonal flow growth proves that soil pores have enlarged
Original teaching assumptions: z=142 m; gaugePressure=196.2 kPa; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; totalHead=142+196.2/9.81=162 m.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：z=142 m; gaugePressure=196.2 kPa; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; totalHead=142+196.2/9.81=162 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: z=142 m; gaugePressure=196.2 kPa; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; totalHead=142+196.2/9.81=162 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 總水頭與共同基準：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Total head and common datum: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「總水頭與共同基準」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Total head and common datum” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將測點水準成果與同日人工水位管讀值交叉比較。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「壓力基準或高程更新未同步會使整組水頭產生固定偏移」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare surveyed sensor elevations against same-day manual standpipe readings. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Unsynchronized pressure or elevation references produce a persistent offset across the head series. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以將測點水準成果與同日人工水位管讀值交叉比較作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對壓力基準或高程更新未同步會使整組水頭產生固定偏移，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Compare surveyed sensor elevations against same-day manual standpipe readings. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Unsynchronized pressure or elevation references produce a persistent offset across the head series. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：壓力基準或高程更新未同步會使整組水頭產生固定偏移。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Unsynchronized pressure or elevation references produce a persistent offset across the head series. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將測點水準成果與同日人工水位管讀值交叉比較。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「壓力基準或高程更新未同步會使整組水頭產生固定偏移」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。
knowledge.textEn: Compare surveyed sensor elevations against same-day manual standpipe readings. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Unsynchronized pressure or elevation references produce a persistent offset across the head series. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時以將測點水準成果與同日人工水位管讀值交叉比較作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對壓力基準或高程更新未同步會使整組水頭產生固定偏移，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Compare surveyed sensor elevations against same-day manual standpipe readings. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Unsynchronized pressure or elevation references produce a persistent offset across the head series. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.

quiz.question: 要驗證「總水頭與共同基準」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Total head and common datum"?
options: 將測點水準成果與同日人工水位管讀值交叉比較。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
整體導水指標就是土樣本身的滲透係數
optionsEn: Compare surveyed sensor elevations against same-day manual standpipe readings.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Bulk hydraulic conductance equals the conductivity of a soil specimen
quiz.explanation: 將測點水準成果與同日人工水位管讀值交叉比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare surveyed sensor elevations against same-day manual standpipe readings. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 總水頭與共同基準：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Total head and common datum: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「總水頭與共同基準」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Total head and common datum” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 壓力基準或高程更新未同步會使整組水頭產生固定偏移。診斷時應採取以下查核：將測點水準成果與同日人工水位管讀值交叉比較，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Unsynchronized pressure or elevation references produce a persistent offset across the head series. Diagnose it by the following check: Compare surveyed sensor elevations against same-day manual standpipe readings. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「孔壓數值可以直接與不同高程的水位相比」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Pressure values can be compared directly with water level at any elevation" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 壓力基準或高程更新未同步會使整組水頭產生固定偏移。診斷時應採取以下查核：將測點水準成果與同日人工水位管讀值交叉比較，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。
knowledge.textEn: Unsynchronized pressure or elevation references produce a persistent offset across the head series. Diagnose it by the following check: Compare surveyed sensor elevations against same-day manual standpipe readings. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「總水頭與共同基準」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Total head and common datum" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
壓力基準或高程更新未同步會使整組水頭產生固定偏移。
流量上升就足以證明壩體正在遭到侵蝕
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Unsynchronized pressure or elevation references produce a persistent offset across the head series.
Rising flow alone proves active erosion within the dam
quiz.explanation: 壓力基準或高程更新未同步會使整組水頭產生固定偏移。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Unsynchronized pressure or elevation references produce a persistent offset across the head series. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 達西流量與梯度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Darcy discharge and gradient: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「達西流量與梯度」如何影響壩體滲流監測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Darcy discharge and gradient” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Seepage monitoring in dams”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 穩定飽和滲流的流量同時受導水截面、滲透係數與水力坡降控制。排水量增加可能只是庫水頭提高，不能單憑流量認定內部沖蝕；反之通道面積改變或排水截流也會改變量測。應先建立同水位工況的比較，再檢查非線性及地下邊界。 驗證時應以同時水頭差與集水流量建立分水位區間的散點圖，並辨識以下失效情境：把降雨旁流併入滲流會誇大推估導水能力。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「達西流量與梯度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Steady saturated flow depends jointly on conducting area, hydraulic conductivity and gradient. Higher drainage may merely reflect higher reservoir head and does not by itself prove internal erosion. Changing pathway area or drain interception also changes measured flow; compare like stages before interpreting nonlinearity or subsurface boundaries. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Plot simultaneous head difference and collected discharge in separate reservoir-stage bands. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Including rainfall bypass in seepage exaggerates inferred hydraulic conductance. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Darcy discharge and gradient” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：k=0.00002 m/s; A=500 m2; deltaHead=12 m; L=50 m; Q=k*A*deltaHead/L=0.0024 m3/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: k=0.00002 m/s; A=500 m2; deltaHead=12 m; L=50 m; Q=k*A*deltaHead/L=0.0024 m3/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「流量上升就足以證明壩體正在遭到侵蝕」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Rising flow alone proves active erosion within the dam" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「達西流量與梯度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Darcy discharge and gradient”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 達西流量與梯度
knowledge.text: 穩定飽和滲流的流量同時受導水截面、滲透係數與水力坡降控制。排水量增加可能只是庫水頭提高，不能單憑流量認定內部沖蝕；反之通道面積改變或排水截流也會改變量測。
knowledge.textEn: Steady saturated flow depends jointly on conducting area, hydraulic conductivity and gradient. Higher drainage may merely reflect higher reservoir head and does not by itself prove internal erosion.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：流量上升就足以證明壩體正在遭到侵蝕 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Rising flow alone proves active erosion within the dam Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「達西流量與梯度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Darcy discharge and gradient" is correct?
options: 流量上升就足以證明壩體正在遭到侵蝕
自由溢流率定可以不管尾水高度直接套用
穩定飽和滲流的流量同時受導水截面、滲透係數與水力坡降控制。
optionsEn: Rising flow alone proves active erosion within the dam
A free-flow rating remains valid regardless of tailwater elevation
Steady saturated flow depends jointly on conducting area, hydraulic conductivity and gradient.
quiz.explanation: 穩定飽和滲流的流量同時受導水截面、滲透係數與水力坡降控制。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Steady saturated flow depends jointly on conducting area, hydraulic conductivity and gradient. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 達西流量與梯度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Darcy discharge and gradient: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「達西流量與梯度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Darcy discharge and gradient” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：k=0.00002 m/s; A=500 m2; deltaHead=12 m; L=50 m; Q=k*A*deltaHead/L=0.0024 m3/s。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: k=0.00002 m/s; A=500 m2; deltaHead=12 m; L=50 m; Q=k*A*deltaHead/L=0.0024 m3/s. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以同時水頭差與集水流量建立分水位區間的散點圖。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Plot simultaneous head difference and collected discharge in separate reservoir-stage bands.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：k=0.00002 m/s; A=500 m2; deltaHead=12 m; L=50 m; Q=k*A*deltaHead/L=0.0024 m3/s。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: k=0.00002 m/s; A=500 m2; deltaHead=12 m; L=50 m; Q=k*A*deltaHead/L=0.0024 m3/s. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「達西流量與梯度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Darcy discharge and gradient", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：k=0.00002 m/s; A=500 m2; deltaHead=12 m; L=50 m; Q=k*A*deltaHead/L=0.0024 m3/s。
儀器反應慢就證明地層孔壓一定變化慢
濁度數字可以直接當作每公升泥砂重量
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: k=0.00002 m/s; A=500 m2; deltaHead=12 m; L=50 m; Q=k*A*deltaHead/L=0.0024 m3/s.
A slow sensor response proves that ground pressure changes slowly
The turbidity number directly equals sediment mass per litre
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：k=0.00002 m/s; A=500 m2; deltaHead=12 m; L=50 m; Q=k*A*deltaHead/L=0.0024 m3/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: k=0.00002 m/s; A=500 m2; deltaHead=12 m; L=50 m; Q=k*A*deltaHead/L=0.0024 m3/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 達西流量與梯度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Darcy discharge and gradient: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「達西流量與梯度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Darcy discharge and gradient” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以同時水頭差與集水流量建立分水位區間的散點圖。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「把降雨旁流併入滲流會誇大推估導水能力」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Plot simultaneous head difference and collected discharge in separate reservoir-stage bands. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Including rainfall bypass in seepage exaggerates inferred hydraulic conductance. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以以同時水頭差與集水流量建立分水位區間的散點圖作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對把降雨旁流併入滲流會誇大推估導水能力，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Plot simultaneous head difference and collected discharge in separate reservoir-stage bands. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Including rainfall bypass in seepage exaggerates inferred hydraulic conductance. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把降雨旁流併入滲流會誇大推估導水能力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Including rainfall bypass in seepage exaggerates inferred hydraulic conductance. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以同時水頭差與集水流量建立分水位區間的散點圖。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「把降雨旁流併入滲流會誇大推估導水能力」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。
knowledge.textEn: Plot simultaneous head difference and collected discharge in separate reservoir-stage bands. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Including rainfall bypass in seepage exaggerates inferred hydraulic conductance. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時以以同時水頭差與集水流量建立分水位區間的散點圖作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對把降雨旁流併入滲流會誇大推估導水能力，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Plot simultaneous head difference and collected discharge in separate reservoir-stage bands. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Including rainfall bypass in seepage exaggerates inferred hydraulic conductance. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.

quiz.question: 要驗證「達西流量與梯度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Darcy discharge and gradient"?

Two sensors sharing one power supply provide independent redundancy

steps.title: 達西流量與梯度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Darcy discharge and gradient: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「達西流量與梯度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Darcy discharge and gradient” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把降雨旁流併入滲流會誇大推估導水能力。診斷時應採取以下查核：以同時水頭差與集水流量建立分水位區間的散點圖，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Including rainfall bypass in seepage exaggerates inferred hydraulic conductance. Diagnose it by the following check: Plot simultaneous head difference and collected discharge in separate reservoir-stage bands. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「流量上升就足以證明壩體正在遭到侵蝕」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Rising flow alone proves active erosion within the dam" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 把降雨旁流併入滲流會誇大推估導水能力。診斷時應採取以下查核：以同時水頭差與集水流量建立分水位區間的散點圖，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。

Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
